title: Keep /cv fonts self-hosted via @fontsource, at most 2 families and 4 weights total; never load fonts from a CDN
body: The CV pages (src/pages/cv.astro, src/pages/en/cv.astro) import @fontsource/manrope 400/600/800 and nothing else. Rules from the 2026-08-14 visual-system spec: max 2 font families and max 4 weights IN TOTAL, because every weight is a file embedded in the printed PDF. Fonts must be self-hosted woff2 from npm (@fontsource/* or equivalent), never Google Fonts or any CDN: the same /cv page is printed by Playwright locally (pdf:local, Windows) and in CI (Ubuntu), and by Cloudflare Browser Rendering in production over the published page, and all of them must produce the same PDF; the site also must not depend on a third party. Adding a family or weight to /cv therefore grows the PDF and must stay self-hosted. Only Manrope's `latin` subset is loaded, so any new glyph in CV output must stay inside it (format.test.ts guards formatMetric; `→` already broke the PDF once). Ligatures stay off on /cv (tokens.css: `fi` extracts as one odd glyph for the parser); src/styles/v2.css turns them back on for /v2 only and must not reach /cv.
not_derivable: Code shows which fonts are imported, not that weights are budgeted because each is embedded in the PDF, or that CDN fonts are banned so local/CI/Browser Rendering print identical PDFs. The spec stating it is being deleted.

evidence.summary: Asserts formatter output stays inside Manrope's latin subset.
Rule set from the deleted spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-14-sistema-visual-design.md §3.2.
